description.p: Red Republic is an isometric city builder in which you run a planned economy. You do not set prices or wait for a market to clear — you decide what gets built, who gets power, and where the lorries go.

Industry runs on physical chains: coal feeds power, power feeds mills, mills feed construction, and machinery wears out and must be replaced. Every delivery is a real vehicle burning real fuel over real roads, and trade crosses a national border that exists on the map.

ul.li: Deterministic simulation — a given map seed always plays out the same way
Interlocking production chains from raw extraction to finished machinery
Deterministic weather and seasons that drive heating demand and freeze the rivers
A freight fleet of individually simulated lorries, each with its own fuel
Physical cross-border trade through staffed customs houses
A power grid whose brownout order is yours to set — the plan or the people
